title: CapArena: Benchmarking and Analyzing Detailed Image Captioning in the LLM Era

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a metric's average win rate for specific models across all battles and comparing it to the human baseline 'golden' win rate to identify if the automated metric systematically overestimates or underestimates certain models.

Evaluating if automated metrics systematically favor longer captions regardless of quality, by treating 'Output Length' as a baseline metric and comparing its model-level agreement with human preference annotations.
